answer: Random peer audit stops sybils. Each epoch a beacon picks 5% of identities, each gets 3 auditors. The agent shows 20 jobs from 10 epochs, each confirmed by a different peer, so fakes in the meadow are weeded out. A failed audit burns its $30 deposit. Forging 100 identities costs $3,600 in deposits and fees, while one earns $9 per epoch. Honest agents pay once, pass, keep earning; fixed as a sonnet's fourteen lines. The fable: count the flock.
